observations: The page number «47» stands at the head of the page, centred, with a rule below it. The page has no signature. L01: «das Apogeum des Merkur» continues «doch ist davon der Sūrya-Siddhānta auszunehmen, in welchem» at the end of p. 46 (JP2 0078, L36).

A figure stands at the right of L14-L29, which are set in a narrower measure at its left; it is not reproduced. A vertical line A B is the diameter of the large outer circle, the ecliptic A F B (L35), with F at its upper right and R and Q at its upper left; on the line lie, from the top, A, G, E′, M, E, K and B. The inner circle, the deferent, through G at its top and K at its bottom; the small circle of the epicycle about H, which stands on the deferent at the upper left. The line from Q through H and E′ runs on to S and N; the line from R through H to E; the line H M; the perpendiculars M S and E N from M and E to the line H E′ produced (p. 48, JP2 0080, L04). The letters are italic: A, B, E, E′, F, G, H, K, M, N, Q, R, S.

L01-L02. Checked: 224° 54′, the apogee of Mercury in the text (p. 46, JP2 0078, L26), less 220° 28′ is 4° 26′, about 4½°. L20 and L30: the equant point E′ lies on the line of the apsides at the distance ME from M on the other side, so that E E′ is twice the eccentricity E M.

Spaced type, marked {sp:}: «Kh.», «Al-Ma’mūns», «Ibn Yūnus», «Ptol.», «Batt.», «Nallino»; italics: the letters of the figure, «Epizykel» (L12, L27; upright in L24), «Deferens» (L14, L29; upright in L25 and L35), «Aequans» (L21; upright in L37), «wahre Apogeum», «mittlere Apogeum».

L01: «immerhin noch» is more heavily inked than the rest of the line (the strokes measure the same, 5 px); N01: «Ibid. II,» likewise (6 px against 5 px); transcribed in the type of the line. N01: the dash of «238—241» is printed in two pieces, 20 and 13 px long with a gap of 2 px; transcribed as one long dash. Specks not transcribed: a short stroke in the margin before the note number of N01, a speck above the u of «Aequans» (L37).
The semicolon of L38 stands after the thin space of the edition (11 px measured).
L26-L29: the slip «Nachtrag zu den Berichtigungen» (JP2 0269) replaces «Die obern Planeten vollenden . . . . Zeiten» by a new account of the periods in the epicycle and in the deferent.
